claims.claim_text: The indexed Joseph A Patterson is linked at high confidence to the official Army record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index and official Army bulk record agree on the exact name and a nonshared protected identifier.

claims.match_notes: Coded Army occupation data are not used as employer evidence.
